name: edge-enforces-policy
description: Clean site whose robots.txt disallows the three probe tokens AND whose edge returns 403 to them: one decision stated twice, enforced correctly. The policy is reported once, by cr.robots.*; the edge probe must not announce a disallowed token, so cr.access.edge_block is not_evaluated and never a second finding.

expected.notes: Before the robots filter this fixture produced a critical cr.access.edge_block on top of the robots findings, with evidence claiming robots.txt was not the cause. Now no token is announced (edge_access.policy lists all three with their rules) and the three edge checks are not_evaluated with reason probe_tokens_disallowed. Everything else matches clean-site because the audit's own user agent is served normally.
